dfb3b8a5-b326-4571-a0cc-677d5f3b6d26.exam_tip_html: the Modern Texts question is a closed-book essay worth 30 marks (+4 SPaG). Embed AO3 context — post-war Irish emigration, the Korean War, IRA history, rural poverty — within analysis of specific moments, not as a separate contextual paragraph. The story's subject is not the father's guilt but what the suspicion does to the narrator's relationship with him — argue this clearly in your introduction.

6965d542-5a2a-41e9-afe8-eddec7e542ca.exam_tip_html: Avoid retelling the plot — instead, explain the effect of specific techniques on the audience.

abb24c07-84b7-459c-8e07-b13861bf2ee2.exam_tip_html: For Group 1: more shells = outer electron further from nucleus = weaker attraction = easier to lose = more reactive. For Group 7: more shells = outer shell further from nucleus = weaker attraction for incoming electron = harder to gain = less reactive.

83f20fe8-e541-4e36-a14f-f76079d61844.exam_tip_html: For Group 1: more shells = outer electron further from nucleus = weaker attraction = easier to lose = more reactive. For Group 7: more shells = outer shell further from nucleus = weaker attraction for incoming electron = harder to gain = less reactive.

3aa02f5c-0a39-446e-9aea-619ef1976288.exam_tip_html: A very common error is to describe general PE knowledge without reference to the data — if the question says “using the data” or “from the graph”, your answer must include specific values from the source material. For percentage change calculations, always divide by the original value (not the new value) and multiply by 100.

9b8fc833-0364-4718-9ecb-4e7a34fae721.exam_tip_html: Don’t write “The British Empire existed” — write “Wells uses the Martian invasion to force Victorian readers to experience colonisation from the perspective of the colonised, critiquing the imperial arrogance that underpinned late-Victorian confidence.” The strongest responses connect context to method and purpose in every paragraph.

5c14459f-41b8-4922-9277-73c75aaea46f.exam_tip_html: Questions about the National Grid often ask you to explain why high voltage is used for transmission. Always name the type of transformer (step-up at the power station, step-down near homes).

f7b0bb14-b582-4aa8-b5f2-d5429d16c4a4.exam_tip_html: Questions about the National Grid often ask you to explain why high voltage is used for transmission. Always name the type of transformer (step-up at the power station, step-down near homes).

13affe23-f79d-4839-a453-4fa348cb7fea.exam_tip_html: For every paragraph, follow PEAD: Point, Evidence, Analysis, Development. In part (ii), range widely across the play (at least 3-4 different scenes) and embed AO4 context in every paragraph, not as a separate section.

77385ee5-7c33-48fd-a7e3-95f4018d1c5d.exam_tip_html: the Modern Texts question is a closed-book essay worth 30 marks (+4 SPaG). For 'Odour of Chrysanthemums', avoid describing the plot. Instead, analyse how Lawrence constructs Elizabeth's revelation through technique: the chrysanthemum motif (tracking its three appearances), the shift in narrative register from flat observation to interior lyric, and the use of the industrial setting as more than backdrop. Do not write about context in a separate paragraph.

69f74ccd-0055-4aa1-a2d2-b0ecfa691693.exam_tip_html: If a question asks about features heard “on the recording,” make sure you include details not shown in the printed score — such as the vocal improvisations in Chorus 3 or the unpitched percussion at the very start. Avoid vague language: “the texture thins in the Outro as instruments drop out one by one” is far stronger than “it gets quieter at the end.”

6f62aafb-7214-45b0-8ee7-f4f6caea2736.exam_tip_html: the Modern Texts question is a closed-book essay worth 30 marks (+4 SPaG). Embed AO3 context — Polish-British history, class in the British school system — within your analysis of specific moments, not as background information. AO4: vary your sentence structures and check your spelling of 'hierarchy' and 'identity'.

c588fa7d-f0c8-443a-97ee-0624c81ace0c.exam_tip_html: When explaining limiting factors, always state which factor is limiting, why it is limiting, and what would happen if you increased it. Show your working clearly.

f2037a2d-53e2-421b-962e-6a7b83b8b5ca.exam_tip_html: Don’t just describe what is visible — explain why it looks the way it does. Practise connecting the physical feature to the political event that caused it.

de9b884a-b443-4043-a065-48342b292f42.exam_tip_html: A common mistake is saying antibiotics kill viruses — they do not.

38b454d6-3ada-4d8f-8adc-b21fb26fc2a7.exam_tip_html: Avoid retelling the plot — instead, explain the effect of specific techniques on the audience.

2b681ffa-d02e-4752-97b5-d3cfc0aa30f1.exam_tip_html: For 8 marks in 10 minutes, aim for 2 developed paragraphs. Use the formula: Poem 1 does [X] using [technique], whereas Poem 2 does [Y] using [different technique], creating a contrast between [effect] and [effect].

ec9de519-69ca-4999-bec4-449d3a103d6d.exam_tip_html: Don’t write “Workhouses were harsh” on its own — instead say “Dickens uses Scrooge’s reference to workhouses to criticise the callous attitudes of the Victorian upper classes.” AO4 (accuracy of writing) also matters, so proofread your response.

deb2d2be-8acd-41b0-83d1-340368bdc37a.exam_tip_html: For 16-mark judgements on why Mary was executed, weigh the Babington letter, the 1585 Act, the Privy Council’s pressure (name Cecil and Walsingham specifically) and the Spanish threat — not just ‘Elizabeth was angry’. Use period vocabulary: cipher, Privy Council, recusancy, Act for the Queen’s Surety, Principal Secretary.

4dc82838-0a74-4f4b-94a8-d65a63a208b3.exam_tip_html: The most common examiner complaint is that students describe what a device is rather than why it suits the audience. For example: “The audience is rural adults [location demographic] — email is a suitable distribution channel [channel] because it works on slow broadband connections that are common in rural areas and does not require a high-speed connection to receive [justification].” Answers that just say “email is fast and easy to use” without referencing the demographic will score poorly.

7cba0c7c-40ee-4493-ab15-a83f52533803.exam_tip_html: Always round resistor values up to the nearest E24 value to ensure current does not exceed the LED’s safe limit.

c8efd441-1c34-45e8-a8a8-fec28a4d4c44.exam_tip_html: When evaluating a historical interpretation, the top band requires you to quote a phrase from the extract and link it explicitly to a named school (e.g. “this reflects the orthodox school because...”). Examiners specifically reward students who can name these schools — do not write “some historians think” when you can name Gaddis or Williams.

c0bbf9db-4dca-41eb-97d6-51f8899a99b2.exam_tip_html: For AO2, discuss the epistolary form as a method.

b50316ba-f8da-4bbc-999e-21089f937cbe.exam_tip_html: A common exam mistake is to say destructive testing ‘breaks the sample’ and leave it there. You must also say why this matters for the product — namely, that the tested sample cannot go into service. For ‘explain’ questions on NDT, state that the part remains intact and can continue to be used after testing.

a3547906-7e60-4aa8-8fea-2e0d6d4c9b40.exam_tip_html: When asked to describe the role of a specific professional, always include a responsibility from more than one stage of the project (design, construction, completion/handover) where possible — this shows depth. Avoid confusing the surveyor (who measures land and sets out works) with the quantity surveyor (who manages costs and payments). If you are asked about "benefits of membership," give at least two distinct benefits such as CPD, professional recognition and access to a professional network.

d80d1b60-25a2-412e-af77-5eb34eb4f1e5.exam_tip_html: The 2-bit counter is one of the most poorly answered topics. Drill these two facts: (1) each D-type stage divides the frequency by 2; (2) the second flip-flop clocks from Q0, not from the external clock. If a question asks for the LED flash frequencies, state Q0 = CLK÷2 and Q1 = CLK÷4 clearly before substituting numbers.

62d76692-e9d5-4f3f-8523-eb7645379994.exam_tip_html: For AO3, never say Orwell was “against communism.” He was a democratic socialist who opposed totalitarianism. In every paragraph, link Orwell’s choices to his political purpose: he uses allegory, satire and fable to expose how power corrupts revolutionary ideals.

ab8f788a-a891-4b6e-bce1-d75a1b52a9a1.exam_tip_html: The Carew murder is one of the novella’s most commonly extracted passages. Pack your analysis with specific language choices — this is where AO2 marks are won.

66dd4a35-aaae-40c0-b27e-19ad9b738b5a.exam_tip_html: Use period-specific vocabulary: fireships, race-built galleons, broadside, circumnavigation, Sea Beggars, Privy Council. For 12-mark causation, connect the factors: Cadiz (1587) damaged Spanish supplies, Hawkins’s redesign gave the English range, the missing deep-water port broke the Parma plan, and the fireships then exploited all of it.

a8c09655-6fca-41d0-8ebc-30b3b6c360bc.exam_tip_html: Remember: the examiner rewards analysis of the writer’s craft (AO1), embedded context (AO3), and accurate use of literary terminology (AO4).

88809522-a9e7-4991-9e13-f3499f053f92.exam_tip_html: The single biggest mistake is writing about one poem, then the other. One well-developed comparison is worth more than five shallow ones.

65786ec8-4227-46ad-9267-8fd996575531.exam_tip_html: In decade counter questions, always check whether a reset pin is connected to an output — if so, the counter resets as soon as that output goes HIGH. The reset output never appears as a stable state in the sequence. Remember that in a common-cathode display, a logic 1 (HIGH) turns a segment ON.

2f31ba18-0aa7-4782-b805-17d93bfc026f.exam_tip_html: If you get this passage, analyse the servants’ fear as a collective response (AO2), the locked door as a symbol of Victorian secrecy (AO2 + AO3), and the discovery of Hyde’s body as the moment where public and private selves collide (AO1).

b68d87a1-a808-4ad2-b1eb-dddf4de3d0aa.exam_tip_html: In bond energy calculations, show your working in three labelled steps (bonds broken, bonds made, overall change) and include the sign: a positive ΔH is endothermic, a negative ΔH is exothermic. Missing units (kJ/mol) or the sign will cost a mark.
